brand.headline: Private messaging. No phone number or e-mail.

welcome.title: Welcome

clear.groupBody: Messages will be removed from this device. You stay in the group.
clear.forGroupHint: Only admins can do this. The history is deleted for every member; the group stays.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: Blocked contacts can no longer send you messages or see when you're online. They will not be notified.

cannotWrite.admins: Only admins can send messages to this group.

composer.caption: Add a caption…

annotate.metadataRemoved: Metadata removed. Sent images are always cleaned automatically anyway.
annotate.metadataFailed: The metadata could not be removed.

voice.micError: Could not access the microphone. Check the permissions and try again.
voice.mask: Anonymize my voice in voice messages
voice.maskHint: Your voice is changed on this device before sending (pitch and timbre, different for every message), so the original never leaves the device. Your words, accent and way of speaking stay. Applies to this device only.
voice.maskError: The voice could not be anonymized, so the message was not sent.
voice.maskTryHint: Record 5 seconds and listen to the result. The sample is not sent or saved.
voice.fxTry: Hear the effects on your voice
voice.fxTryHint: Record 5 seconds, then listen to every effect. The sample is not sent or saved. Pick effects with ✨ while recording a voice message or during a call.

message.noDevices: {{name}} has no connected device right now. The message will be sent when they come back online.
message.sendFailed: The message could not be sent
message.sendRetrying: The message could not be sent yet, retrying
message.suspiciousLink: Check this link: its address uses unusual characters or a user name, and may imitate another site.
message.dangerousBody: “{{name}}” is a program, script or installer. Opening it can harm your computer. Save it only if you trust the sender and expected this file.
message.accountGone: This account no longer exists. The message can't be delivered.

location.hint: Click on the map to choose a place, or use your current location.
location.unavailable: Your location is not available. Choose a place on the map instead.
location.name: Place name
location.mapPrivacy: The map is loaded from OpenStreetMap, which then learns this area and your IP address.

qr.myCodeHint: Others can scan this code to add you as a contact.

If you run it with "pnpm tauri dev", the permission belongs to the terminal app you started it from (Terminal, iTerm, VS Code…): enable that one, then fully quit and reopen the terminal. Meanwhile you can scan from an image or paste the link.
qr.noCamera: No camera found. Scan from an image, paste a screenshot or paste the link.
qr.cameraUnsupported: The camera is not available in this window. Scan from an image or paste the link.
qr.pasteImageHint: You can also paste a screenshot of the code (⌘V / Ctrl+V) or drop it here.

newChat.byQrHint: Scan the code, pick an image or paste a link
newChat.byPhoneHint: Optional: import your address book in Settings
newChat.invalidTarget: Enter a 16-digit number or a username (3–32 characters: a–z, 0–9, _ and .).

contact.name: Name

contact.numberOnly: This contact has no profile name, so their number {{number}} is shown.

group.onlyAdminsEdit: Only admins can edit group info

safety.match: The safety numbers match. The contact has been marked as verified.
safety.mismatch: The code doesn't match. Make sure you are scanning the code shown for your chat with {{name}}.
safety.compare: Compare this number with the one shown on {{name}}'s device. If they match, the conversation is secure.

profile.cameraHint: Center your face in the circle.
profile.cameraReview: This is how your profile photo will look.
profile.cameraDenied: macOS is blocking camera access. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Camera and enable {{appName}}. profile.noCamera: No camera found. You can choose a photo from a file instead.
profile.cameraUnsupported: The camera is not available in this window. Choose a photo from a file instead.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name

account.title: Account
account.phoneHint: Lets people who have your number in their address book find you. Your number is never shown to others.
account.phoneUnsupported: This server does not support phone number discovery.
account.codeHint: Enter the code we sent you by SMS.
account.discoverableHint: People with your number in their contacts can find your account.
account.deleteWarning: This cannot be undone. Your account number will stop working, all your devices will be logged out, your groups will be left and your backup will be erased. Your recovery phrase will not be able to bring it back.
account.deleteConfirm: Type the last 4 digits of your account number ({{digits}}) to confirm
account.changePasswordHint: Used to log in on other devices
account.qrHint: So that others can add you as a contact
account.recoveryAsk: For your safety, enter your account password to show the 24 words.
account.recoveryHint: Asks for your password to show it
account.recoveryShown: Make sure nobody is watching. Write the words down in order and keep them offline.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.readReceiptsHint: If you turn them off, you won't see other people's read receipts either.
privacy.typingHint: Show when you are typing a message.
privacy.lockHint: Asks for your password when the app starts.

relock.title: Lock again after the app was in the background
relock.hint: The app always asks for the password when it starts. Choose whether it should also lock again while it keeps running.

again.start: It stays unlocked until you close the app.
again.min1: Also locks again after 1 minute in the background.
again.min5: Also locks again after 5 minutes in the background.
again.hour1: Also locks again after 1 hour in the background.

privacy.onlineHint: Who can see when you are online. If you turn it off, nobody sees you online or when you were last active.
privacy.previewHint: Show the message text in notifications.
privacy.screenshotsHint: Hides the app window from screenshots and screen recordings on this device.
privacy.screenshotsPause: Turning it off is temporary: it turns itself back on after 60 minutes.
privacy.screenshotsPaused: Paused: back on in {{minutes}} min. Turn it on to protect the window again now.
privacy.screenshotsPlatforms: Works on macOS and Windows (not supported on Linux).

devices.title: Devices
devices.descriptionMax_one: You can use your account on up to {{count}} device at the same time.
devices.descriptionMax_other: You can use your account on up to {{count}} devices at the same time.
devices.unlinkBody: The device will be logged out and its local data erased.
devices.intro: Linked devices can send and receive messages as you. Unlink any session you don't recognize.
devices.inactiveWarning: Inactive for {{days}} days: it will be unlinked automatically after 30 days
devices.approvalHint: A login with your password must be approved on one of your devices. Logging in with your recovery phrase still works (it signs out all other devices).

chats.title: Chats
chats.backupHint: Keeps an end-to-end encrypted copy of your chats on the server so new devices can restore them. The server can't read it.
chats.importHint: Upload a .vcf or .csv file to find contacts who made their phone number discoverable. Phone numbers are hashed before being compared.
chats.importResult: {{total}} contacts read, {{withPhone}} with a phone number, {{matched}} found on {{appName}}.
chats.importPrivacy: Contacts that are not on {{appName}} are not stored.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.dirAHint: Flush panes, paper tones, Plus Jakarta Sans.
appearance.dirBHint: Rounded cards on a cool canvas, gradient bubbles, Figtree.
appearance.textSizeHint: Scales the whole interface on this device.

about.title: About
about.signal: Messages, attachments and group chats are end-to-end encrypted with the Signal Protocol (X3DH, the Double Ratchet and Sender Keys for groups). Only you and the people you talk to can read them; the server only relays encrypted data.
about.openSource: {{appName}} is free and open source software, licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0).
about.tagline: End-to-end encrypted messaging. Tauri 2 client, cryptographic core in Rust.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.desktopHint: Show a system notification when a new message arrives.
notifications.soundHint: Play a sound for messages in other chats or while the app is in the background.
notifications.soundInChatHint: A short, subtle sound for messages in the chat you are reading.
notifications.badgeHint: Show the number of unread messages on the Dock / taskbar icon.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked by the system. On macOS: System Settings → Notifications → {{appName}} (or your terminal app when running "pnpm tauri dev") → allow notifications.
notifications.testBody: This is how a new message notification looks.
notifications.mutedHint: Muted chats show no notifications and play no sounds.

blocked.title: Blocked contacts
blocked.hint: Blocked contacts can't send you messages or see when you're online. They are not notified.
blocked.empty: You can block someone from their chat or contact info.

username.title: Username
username.hint: Lets people find you by @username instead of your account number. Your number stays private.
username.label: Username
username.rules: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and . — must start with a letter.
username.errChars: Only lowercase letters a–z, digits, _ and . are allowed.
username.errStart: The username must start with a letter.
username.errNumber: The number after the last dot needs 2–9 digits, not all zeros, and a leading 0 only in 2-digit numbers like .07.
username.numberHint: Tip: end your username with a number like .27 so you can keep a popular name. Existing usernames keep working.
username.linkHint: Anyone who scans this code or opens the link can find you by your username. The link itself does not contain your account number.
username.linkResetConfirm: Reset your username link? The current link and QR code will stop working.

calls.title: Calls
calls.allowHint: Voice and video calls, including group calls. When off, calls don't ring on any of your devices and callers see that you don't accept calls.
calls.relayOnly: Calls only through the {{appName}} server (hides your IP address)
calls.relayOnlyHint: Direct calls are faster, but the other person's device can learn your IP address. Relayed calls hide it but may have slightly lower quality.

link.confirmBody: It will be able to send and receive messages as you. Only confirm if it is yours.
link.confirmOtherHint: Approve the link on the device where you are already signed in.
link.differentServer: This code belongs to an account on another server.
link.expiredHint: The code was already used or has expired. Generate a new one and try again.
link.scanExisting: Scan the code shown on the new device, on its log-in screen.
link.scanNew: Point the camera at the QR code shown on your other device, in Settings → Devices.
link.showExisting: Scan this code from the new device, on its log-in screen.
link.showNew: Scan this code from a signed-in device: Settings → Devices → Link a device.
link.validity: The code is valid for 5 minutes
link.sasConfirmHint: Only approve if the new device shows exactly this code. It can then send and receive messages as you.
link.sasWaitHint: Approve on your other device only if it shows this same code.

lock.enableHint: Confirm your account password. It will be asked when the app starts; you can also choose to lock it again after it was in the background.
lock.lead: Enter your account password to continue.
lock.title: App lock

layout.resizeHint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset

lookup.title: Start a conversation
lookup.notFoundPhone: Nobody has made this phone number findable.

shareContacts.title: Send contacts
shareContacts.hint: Pick one or more people from your contacts.

call.title: Voice call
call.unsupported: Voice calls are not available on this system (no WebRTC support).
call.cameraError: Camera unavailable: the call continues with audio only.
call.callsOffHint: Turn on calls in Settings → Privacy
call.callsOffBanner: Calls are turned off in Settings
call.relayUnavailable: Relay calls are not available on this server

quality.mine: Your connection is weak: your voice may break up
quality.cameraStopped: Your camera stopped automatically so the voice stays clear (weak connection). You can turn it back on.

kt.title: Key transparency
kt.alertTitle: Security alert: the server's key log is inconsistent
kt.alertHint: Someone may be trying to intercept your messages. Verify safety numbers in person with your contacts.

statusHint.verified: This security key is the one recorded for this contact in the server's public, append-only key log.
statusHint.pending: The key has not been checked against the server's key log yet. It is checked automatically when the server can be reached.
statusHint.alert: This security key does not match the server's public key log. Do not trust this conversation until you have compared safety numbers in person.
statusHint.unavailable: This server does not publish a key log.

kind.split_view: a contact sees a different version of the key log than you
kind.fork: the server showed two different versions of the key log
kind.rollback: the server went back to an older version of the key log
kind.bad_signature: the key log is not signed by this server's key
kind.key_mismatch: a contact's security key does not match the key log
kind.own_key_mismatch: the key log lists a security key for your account that is not yours
kind.log_mismatch: the server's key log proofs do not verify
kind.log_key_changed: the server's key log signing key changed

security.newDeviceHint: If this wasn't you, unlink it and change your password.
security.loginRequestBody: Someone with your password is logging in on {{name}} ({{platform}}) at {{date}}. Approve only if this is you.
security.waitingBody: Your account requires new logins to be approved. Approve this login on one of your other devices; the request expires in 10 minutes.
security.loginExpired: The login was not approved in time. Try again.
security.reportBody: The account is reported to the server for review and blocked. Messages stay end-to-end encrypted: the report does not include their content.
security.conflictOwn: A device with a security key that does not belong to your account tried to join it. Nothing is sent to it. Check your linked devices and remove any you do not recognize.
security.conflictPeer: {{name}}'s account shows a device with a different security key. Messages to it are blocked so nobody else can read them.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.on: On: login also asks for a code
totp.loginHint: Open your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…) and enter the code shown for {{appName}}.
totp.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
totp.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app:
totp.disableHint: Enter a current code from your authenticator app.
totp.recoveryNote: If you lose your authenticator app, recovering the account with the 24 words turns two-step verification off.
totp.nudgeText: Turn on two-step verification: even if someone learns your password, they cannot log in without the code from your phone.

wipe.title: Delete all conversations?
wipe.body: All your conversations are deleted, here and for the others:
wipe.point1: In private chats the conversation disappears for the other person too: right away, or automatically when they come online.
wipe.point2: In groups, the messages you sent disappear for every member.
wipe.point3: On this device the messages, received files and the space they used in the database are wiped.

dnd.title: Do not disturb
dnd.hint: Calls don't ring and messages make no sound or notification.
dnd.description: Calls don't ring on any of your devices and become missed calls; callers only see that you didn't answer. Messages still arrive, without sounds or notifications.

temporary.title: Temporary mode
temporary.hint: Chats work normally, but nothing is kept on this device: after a restart every conversation and file is gone.
temporary.badgeHint: Temporary mode is on: conversations are erased when the app closes.
temporary.enableBody: Your conversations stay visible until you close the app, but they are removed from the disk right now. After a restart, all chats, messages and received files on this device are gone. Contacts and groups are kept.
temporary.disableBody: The conversations you have open now will be saved on this device again, together with everything that follows.

dataLock.unlockLead: Your chats on this device are encrypted with your account password. Enter it to open them.
dataLock.protectTitle: Protect the data on this device
dataLock.protectLead: Enter your account password. From now on, the chats saved on this device can only be opened with it.
dataLock.wrongPassword: Wrong password. If you changed it on another device, use the previous password here.
dataLock.forgot: Forgot the password? Reset this device
dataLock.resetBody: Without the password, the data on this device cannot be decrypted by anyone, so it will be deleted. Then log in again, or recover the account with your 24 words; if backup is on, your history comes back. This device stays in your device list until you remove it from another device.
dataLock.outdatedLead: The account password was changed on another device. The data on this device is still locked with the old one: enter the new password to use it here too.
dataLock.updated: The data on this device now uses the new password

groupRules.title: Group rules
groupRules.timerHint: Applies to every member; only admins can change it.
groupRules.showMembers: Members can see the member list
groupRules.showMembersHint: When off, members only see how many there are. Admins always see everyone.
groupRules.firstNamesHint: Every member must set a profile name; account numbers are hidden and only the first name is shown.
groupRules.hiddenNotice: The admins have hidden the member list.

pin.title: Pin for how long?
pin.hint: Pins stay on this device only. A chat can have up to 3; pinning another one replaces the oldest.

star.title: Starred messages
star.emptyHint: Star a message to find it here. Stars stay on this device only and expire after 7 days.

invite.title: Invite via link
invite.hint: Anyone with the link can see the group's name and description and join (or ask to join). The link's secret never reaches the server.
invite.approvalHint: An admin must approve each person who joins with the link.
invite.shareHint: Share it only with people you trust. Removing a member replaces the link.
invite.resetBody: The current link will stop working. Pending requests are kept.
invite.bannedHint: People an admin removed, or whose request was declined, can't rejoin with the link. Unban someone to let them join again.
invite.noBanned: No one is banned from this group.
invite.unbanned: {{name}} can join with the link again.
invite.notALink: Paste a link that starts with chatapp://join/
invite.needsApproval: An admin must approve your request.

request.title: {{name}} wants to message you
request.body: This account is not in your contacts. Until you accept, they don't see that you read their messages, can't see your profile or when you're online, their calls don't ring and nothing they send is downloaded.
request.groupBody: Someone who is not in your contacts added you to this group. Until you join, nothing is downloaded and the members don't see that you read their messages.
request.blockBody: They can no longer message or call you. The request is deleted.
request.deleteBody: The request and its messages are deleted from this device. If they write again, you get a new request.
request.declineBody: You leave the group and it is deleted from this device.
request.downloadBody: This was sent by someone you have not accepted yet. Only download files from people you trust.

groupCall.videoHint: Group video call (with more than {{count}} people, audio works better)
groupCall.title: Group call

viewOnce.toggleOn: View once is on: the recipient can open this photo or video only once
viewOnce.onlyOne: View once works with a single photo or video
viewOnce.closeHint: This media disappears when you close it
viewOnce.voiceHint: This voice message plays only once and disappears when it ends or you close it
viewOnce.voiceToggleOn: View once is on: the recipient can listen to this voice message only once

profiles.title: Accounts on this computer
profiles.lead: Choose an account and enter its password. Your chats open right here, without logging in again.
profiles.forgetTitle: Delete this account from this computer?
profiles.forgetBody: Without the password, the data of this account on this computer cannot be decrypted by anyone, so it will be deleted. You can log in again or recover the account with your 24 words; if backup is on, your history comes back. This device stays in the account's device list until you remove it from another device.
profiles.login: Log in to an existing account
profiles.other: Open another account on this computer
profiles.otherLead: For an account that is hidden from the start screen: enter its full account number and its password.
profiles.switchHint: Goes back to the start screen. The account stays open until you quit the app, so you can come back without a password.
profiles.showOnStart: Show this account on the start screen
profiles.showOnStartHint: Shows only the name, the last 4 digits and the server. When off, open it with “Open another account on this computer” and the full account number.
profiles.removeTitle: Log out of this account on this computer?
profiles.logoutSwitchExplain: the account stays on this computer, locked with its password. Your chats stay here, nothing is deleted, and you can open it again anytime.
profiles.logoutRemoveExplain: this computer is disconnected from the account and its messages are deleted from it. If chat backup is off, history that isn't on your other devices is lost. If this is your only device, people can't reach you until you log in again.
profiles.lastDeviceTitle: This is the only device of {{name}}
profiles.lastDeviceBody: This is the only device of {{name}}. After you log out, the account cannot receive messages until you log in again with the account number and password (or recovery phrase). Make sure you have them.
profiles.remoteWiped_one: This computer was removed from one of the accounts saved here. That account's data was deleted from this computer.
profiles.remoteWiped_other: This computer was removed from {{count}} of the accounts saved here. Their data was deleted from this computer.
profiles.lockedHint: Asks for its password once, until you quit the app

retention.title: Delete photos, videos, voice messages and files after
retention.hint: Applies to all conversations, sent and received, on all your devices. Older media is deleted at once. 30 days is the longest allowed.

voiceFx.title: Effect for your voice
voiceFx.error: The voice effect could not be started: the call goes on with your normal voice.
voiceFx.denoiseHint: Removes background noise from your microphone in calls (traffic, keyboard, wind, people talking nearby), on this computer, before it is sent. You can also turn it on or off during a call, from ✨.

name.title: What's your name?
name.lead: The name your friends see in chats. It can be your real name or a nickname, and you can change it any time.
